svg.title: Example with made-up inputs: bonus CT Money on a boot
svg.desc: Example with made-up inputs. A made-up 200 dollar boot earns a made-up 1 percent base, which is 2 dollars, versus a made-up 5-times bonus added on top, which is 12 dollars in total. Redemption is shown at 1 dollar for 1 dollar. These rates are not the published 0.4 percent Triangle Rewards column.
svg.text: Example with made-up inputs: a $200 boot
Made-up 1 percent base. Not the published 0.4 percent rate. Redeemed $1 for $1.
Arithmetic: 1 percent of $200 is $2. Five times that base is $10 of bonus.
$2 plus $10 is $12. The program's real example is different: $8 bonus on $100 at 20 times.
Replace the made-up rate with the offer on your account. Gift cards do not qualify.
Saving Optimizer. Example with made-up inputs. As of 29 Sep 2026.
